native_reviewer_checklist: Does every line read as if written in Germany (or Spain)? Mark any phrase that sounds translated.
Is Sie (usted) right and used in every line, button and SMS?
Are Terminerinnerung per SMS, Terminausfälle reduzieren and Salon-Software the words German salon and clinic owners use?
Do the net prices with 'zzgl. MwSt.', the numbers, dates, times and units follow local use?
Is every flagged claim true and allowed in Germany, including the data protection wording and 'kostenlos' for the first 100 SMS?
Do 'J' and 'V' read naturally as SMS replies (Ja, Verschieben), and has the product team confirmed the reply handler accepts them?
Do the swapped examples (Brückentage, a regional holiday) fit your customers?
Does each line still do its job next to its back-translation?
In the ad preview and on the live page: does any line, button or the SMS break, wrap badly or get cut?
